Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the phosphorus content in dishwashing detergent.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the phosphorus content in dishwashingdetergent; and amending RCW 70.95L.005 and 70.95L.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.95L.005 and 1993 c 118 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature hereby finds and declares that: (1) Phosphorus loading of surface waters can stimulate the growthof weeds and algae, and that such growth can have adverseenvironmental, health, and aesthetic effects; (2) Household detergents contribute to phosphorus loading, and thata limit on detergents containing phosphorus can significantly reducethe discharge of phosphorus into the state's surface and ground waters; (3) Household detergents containing no or very low phosphorus arereadily available and that over thirty percent of the United Statespopulation lives in areas with a ban on detergents containingphosphorus; ((and)) (4) Phosphorus limits on household detergents can significantlyreduce treatment costs at those sewage treatment facilities that removephosphorus from the waste stream; and p. 1 HB 2322 (5) While significant reductions of phosphorus from laundrydetergent have been accomplished, similar progress in reducingphosphorus contributions from dishwashing detergents has not beenachieved. It is therefore the intent of the legislature to impose a statewidelimit on the phosphorus content of household detergents.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.95L.020 and 1993 c 118 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) After July 1, 1994, a person may not sell or distribute forsale a laundry detergent that contains 0.5 percent or more phosphorusby weight. (2) After July 1, ((1994)) 2007, a person may not sell ordistribute for sale a dishwashing detergent that contains ((8.7)) 0.5percent or more phosphorous by weight. (3) This section does not apply to the sale or distribution ofdetergents for commercial and industrial uses.
